description:
Update internal budget request/response tool built on SharePoint2010/InfoPath, which interfaces with the corporate employee database and expense reports. Familiarize themselves with the tool, streamline and improve the current UI to enhance the overall user experience, propose additional solutions/capabilities to make the tool more dynamic and user-friendly. Administrative duties as needed (responding to user bug reports, data entry, possibly user training). Capable of working independently to investigate and solve problems. 

 SharePoint 2010 and 2013 
 Complex workflows expert 
 SharePoint Designer, InfoPath and SSRS reports 
 Able to collect requirements, analyze results, propose an optimal solution while articulating tradeoffs, and deploy the solution with detailed documentation 
 Must be able to work autonomously 
 3 or more years of relevant SharePoint experience 
 Preferred Skills:  

 Good customer facing skills 
 BS degree in relevant/related field. 
 Creative problem solving and application building experience required 
 Past Intel experience is a plus
 
 
 PLEASE NOTE THAT WE ARE NOT ABLE TO WORK WITH CANDIDATES ON H1B VISAS OR CANDIDATES REPRESENTED BY THIRD PARTIES.
